name: Flapper Drones

name: Mapture.ai
description: Over the past years, we have seen drones being used more and more for various applications. However, we believe that this is just the tip of the iceberg. The true potential of drones will be unleashed when they no longer require a drone-pilot. Drones are perfectly able to fly by themselves. Our drone-in-a-box solution offers completely automated data acquisition without the need for a drone-pilot.

name: Pats
description: Our bio-inspired solution proactively controls harmful insect populations. The bat-like drones work autonomously and keep plagues in check. By selectively eliminating harmful insects the ecological balance in a greenhouse ecosystem is sustained.

name: Shore Systems
description: Shore Systems is specialised in the development, design and production of hydrogen powered VTOL drones with unprecedented range and hover capabilities.
